items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury. Sean McVay said he is not making great progress and the team is being cautious though it is not a long-term concern; Nacua may miss Sunday.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP; McVay: not making great progress, err on side of caution.
items.implication: Elevates Davante Adams to clear WR1 role with high target share.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua; recent 8-195-2 production.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers missed a second straight practice with hamstring injury; expected to miss a second consecutive game, including Brazil trip.
items.why: Second DNP; first injured Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated after Week 1 5-150-1 half.
items.implication: Ravens WR targets redistribute; limited upside for others in Brazil game.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart expected to have knee surgery (meniscus/MCL/PCL, ACL intact) ending his 2026 regular season; possible playoff return if team goes deep. Coach confirmed.
items.why: Surgery required; full recovery expected but season over for regular season.
items.implication: Giants QB situation unstable long-term; impacts passing game.

items.text: Comprehensive hurt list: WR/TE/QB includes Puka Nacua, Nico Collins, Brock Bowers, AJ Brown, Zay Flowers, Jayden Daniels, Caleb Williams, Jaxson Dart, Jayden Reed, others. RBs: meh committee backs Jonathon Brooks, Rico Dowdle, Jordan Mason.
items.why: Multiple key skill players sidelined or limited heading into Week 3.
items.implication: Monitor for role expansions and handcuffs; Dart season-ending already confirmed.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries in affected offenses; avoid or fade injured.

items.text: TNF questions: Has Marshawn Lloyd totally blown chance and ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Is Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London and Kyle Pitts? Does Jayden Reed absence lead to more 2-TE sets? Can Packers OL hold for Christian Watson?
items.why: Role and health questions heading into Thursday night game.
items.implication: London/Pitts upside if Penix good; Lloyd fade risk; Watson dependent on OL.
items.opportunity: Penix-London historical synergy; monitor Lloyd snap share vs Johnson.

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz was targeted on 30% of routes and finished with team-high 28% target share. Week 3 vs Colts who allow 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Massive target spike and volume without Collins; favorable TE matchup.
items.implication: Schultz TE1/ high-end TE2 start if Collins out again.
items.opportunity: 30% TPRR, 28% share; Colts TE DVP soft.

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson first-quarter fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield with 65% snap rate and out-touched Stevenson 16-5 rest of game. Outlook improved but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3 as team distrusts Henderson pass pro.
items.why: Post-fumble snap/touch dominance; gap narrowed but not full takeover.
items.implication: Henderson rising handcuff/ flex; Stevenson still preferred short-term.
items.opportunity: 65% snaps, 16 touches post-fumble; monitor pass-pro trust.
items.conflict: Berry ranks Stevenson ahead despite usage spike.

items.text: Drake London has played 12 career games with Michael Penix: averages over 20 PPR points, 35% target share, 97 receiving yards per game.
items.why: Elite historical production and target share with Penix at QB.
items.implication: London WR1 upside revived with Penix healthy for TNF and beyond.
items.opportunity: 35% share, 20+ PPR avg in sample; Pitts also benefits.

items.text: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold is on a good track to return Sunday vs Commanders after missing most of first two games with glute injury; HC Macdonald confirmed.
items.why: HC: on good track after glute issue.
items.implication: Stabilizes Seahawks offense and JSN/others for Week 3.
items.opportunity: Positive for SEA pass catchers if full go.

items.text: Week 3 snaps & pace: CAR @ CLE up in pace; MIN @ TB slow slogs. Full breakdown from Pat Thorman available; rankings and ROS Top 150 updated.
items.implication: Prefer players in up-tempo games like CAR-CLE for higher opportunity.

items.text: Through 2 weeks MarShawn Lloyd averaging 38% snap rate and 10.5 touches per game. Same red-zone touches as Chris Brooks; fewer rush attempts than Kaleb Johnson in Week 2.
items.why: Modest but consistent committee share; competition from Johnson.
items.implication: Not a clear lead back; Levitan questions if he has ceded role.
items.conflict: Levitan TNF note on possible cede to Johnson.

items.text: In 10 games with Marcus Mariota, Terry McLaurin averaged 25% target share and over 11 YPT; last season Mariota starts ~14 FP. Berry would not start vs Seattle but Daniels injury does not completely tank value.
items.why: Solid historical share with backup; tough matchup this week.
items.implication: Sit Week 3 vs SEA but maintain ROS value if Daniels out longer.
